claims.claim: Researchers estimate Mars north pole ice contains only three percent dust by mass instead of twenty five percent.
claims.episode_span: Researchers now estimate Mars north pole ice contains only three percent dust by mass instead of the prior twenty five percent figure.
claims.source_title: Mars' North Pole Ice Is Far Cleaner Than Expected
claims.supporting_quote: this new study has redone these calculations based on similar ice-dust research on Earth, with the researchers providing a new estimate that the top layer of north pole water ice contains a dust by mass of about 3 percent, far lower than the previous estimate of 25 percent.

claims.claim: A study in Mayo Clinic Proceedings found elevated hip fracture rates after flights exceeding ninety days.
claims.episode_span: A study in Mayo Clinic Proceedings examined U.S. astronauts and found elevated hip fracture rates after flights exceeding ninety days.
claims.source_title: 90-plus-day spaceflights linked to higher rates of hip fractures in astronauts
claims.supporting_quote: New research has found that the rate of hip fractures among astronauts after spaceflights lasting more than 90 days was higher than after shorter spaceflights or among people who were not astronauts.
